system.boundary: Build a complete complex-baseband QPSK communication link in Simulink.
engineering_objects: TxBits and RxBits must be the physical payload-bit streams compared by the receiver;
physical_paths: A framed payload source must feed Gray-coded QPSK modulation and pulse shaping, followed by a channel that applies additive noise, carrier frequency and phase error, and time-varying fractional-sample delay; a practical receiver must recover the payload through gain stabilization, carrier and symbol synchronization, frame acquisition, phase-ambiguity correction, and decoding.
TxBits and RxBits must be the physical payload-bit streams compared by the receiver;
functional_paths: Across the declared range, the receiver must acquire valid frames and recover the transmitted payload while tracking the declared carrier and timing impairments.
